sloka: प्रशान्तपीडाबहुलो नष्टारिष्टः प्रतापवान्।बभूव लोकः पतिते राक्षसेन्द्रसुते तदा ।। ६.९१.८६ ।।
transliteration: praśāntapīḍābahulo naṣṭāriṣṭaḥ pratāpavān।babhūva lokaḥ patite rākṣasendrasute tadā ।। 6.91.86 ।।

translations.english: Then many were at peace and rejoiced in the world, being relieved, when Ravana's son dropped dead.
